babyAmnioticFluidAlertGuidance: Amniotic fluid alert: increase fetal surveillance for meconium and start broad-spectrum IV antibiotics for suspected infection when foul odor is present.
babyBaselineFhrAlertGuidance: Baseline FHR alert: reposition left lateral, optimize perfusion, stop/reduce oxytocin if needed, reassess quickly, and escalate to continuous monitoring with expedited delivery preparation when persistent.
babyCaputAlertGuidance: Caput +++ alert: evaluate for cephalopelvic disproportion or malposition and prepare operative delivery if progress is halted.
babyCaputTokenHoverGuidance: Caput +++: reassess for possible cephalopelvic disproportion or malposition, correlate with cervical progress/descent, and prepare operative delivery if labour is not progressing safely.
babyDataSaved: Baby well-being data has been saved
babyFetalPositionAlertGuidance: Fetal position alert: reassess fetal position and descent, use corrective maternal positioning, and escalate review if persistent with poor progress.
babyFhrDecelerationAlertGuidance: FHR deceleration alert: optimize maternal condition and monitor continuously; prepare for expedited delivery if recurrent or persistent.
babyFhrDecelerationTokenHoverGuidance: FHR deceleration: optimize maternal position and perfusion, reassess immediately, and escalate to continuous monitoring. Prepare expedited delivery if abnormal tracing persists.

babyMouldingTokenHoverGuidance: Moulding +++: reassess for possible cephalopelvic disproportion or malposition, correlate with cervical progress/descent, and prepare operative delivery if labour is not progressing safely.

cervixGuidance: In active first stage, plot 'X' to record cervical dilatation. Alert triggered when lag time for current cervical dilatation is exceeded with no progress. In second stage, insert 'P' to indicate when pushing begins.
cervixHourlyRule: Cervical dilation reopens on the next 1-hour labour progress slot

cervixRangeValidation: Cervix must be between 5 and 10 cm
cervixStallTokenGuidance: Cervical dilation stall: perform a full three-P assessment (powers, passenger, passage). If contractions are inadequate consider amniotomy/oxytocin; if adequate but no progress, evaluate for CPD and prepare for operative delivery.

contractionCountTokenGuidance: Contractions <=2 or >5 per 10 min: for hyperstimulation stop/reduce oxytocin and stabilize; for inadequate contractions consider amniotomy/oxytocin after fetal safety check.
contractionDurationAlertGuidance: Contraction duration alert: reassess labour powers and fetal condition; if contractions are inadequate support augmentation, if excessive with distress reduce stimulation and stabilize mother/fetus.
contractionDurationTokenGuidance: Contraction duration <20s or >60s: reassess powers, passenger, and passage; optimize uterine activity while maintaining fetal safety.
contractionsPer10AlertGuidance: Contractions per 10 min alert: if >5 (hyperstimulation), stop/reduce oxytocin, left-lateral position, and consider tocolysis when fetal distress is present. If <2 (inadequate), consider amniotomy or oxytocin augmentation after confirming fetal well-being.

supportiveCompanionAlertGuidance: Companion N: Immediately facilitate the woman's chosen companion to be present and oriented in the room. If unavailable, assign a dedicated midwife, nurse, or doula for continuous one-on-one support.
supportiveCompanionTokenHoverGuidance: Companion N: Immediately facilitate the woman's chosen companion to be present and oriented in the room. If unavailable, assign a dedicated midwife, nurse, or doula for continuous one-on-one support.
supportiveOralFluidAlertGuidance: Oral fluid N: Encourage oral hydration and energy fluids (water, clear juice, isotonic drinks) unless there is a clear documented contraindication such as imminent general anesthesia.
supportiveOralFluidTokenHoverGuidance: Oral fluid N: Encourage oral hydration and energy fluids (water, clear juice, isotonic drinks) unless there is a clear documented contraindication such as imminent general anesthesia.
supportivePainReliefAlertGuidance: Pain relief N: Assess pain using a standard scale, offer non-pharmacological options first (breathing, massage, warm compress, position changes), and give prescribed pharmacological analgesia if needed per protocol.
supportivePainReliefTokenHoverGuidance: Pain relief N: Assess pain using a standard scale, offer non-pharmacological options first (breathing, massage, warm compress, position changes), and give prescribed pharmacological analgesia if needed per protocol.
supportivePostureAlertGuidance: Posture SP: Encourage walking or upright mobility; if in bed, support lateral, upright, or semi-recumbent positions. Avoid prolonged supine position to reduce aortocaval compression risk.
supportivePostureTokenHoverGuidance: Posture SP: Encourage walking or upright mobility; if in bed, support lateral, upright, or semi-recumbent positions. Avoid prolonged supine position to reduce aortocaval compression risk.

womanDiastolicAlertGuidance: Diastolic BP alert: evaluate and manage hypertensive disease urgently, including proteinuria screening and severe-feature assessment; escalate treatment per protocol.
womanDiastolicTokenGuidance: Diastolic BP alert: evaluate hypertensive disease urgently with proteinuria and danger-sign review; escalate treatment per protocol.
womanPulseAlertGuidance: Pulse alert: assess for dehydration, pain, anxiety, fever, or bleeding; optimize hydration and pain control, then recheck promptly and manage hemorrhage urgently when suspected.
womanPulseTokenGuidance: Pulse alert: assess cause (dehydration, pain, anxiety, fever, hemorrhage), optimize hydration and pain control, and recheck promptly.
womanSystolicAlertGuidance: Systolic BP alert: for elevated BP, evaluate pre-eclampsia signs and urine protein; treat severe hypertension per protocol including antihypertensives and magnesium sulfate when indicated. For low BP, left lateral tilt, rapid IV fluids, and assess for bleeding.
womanSystolicTokenGuidance: Systolic BP alert: for high values evaluate pre-eclampsia and severe features; for low values position left lateral, give IV fluids, and assess for bleeding.
womanTemperatureAlertGuidance: Temperature alert: confirm hydration, institute cooling and infection assessment, check liquor odor and maternal pulse, start empirical IV antibiotics when intrapartum infection is suspected, and increase FHR monitoring frequency.
womanTemperatureTokenGuidance: Temperature alert: evaluate for intrapartum infection, hydrate/cool, start empirical IV antibiotics when indicated, and increase fetal monitoring.
womanUrineAlertGuidance: Urine alert: correlate proteinuria with BP for pre-eclampsia assessment; treat ketonuria with oral intake support or IV dextrose where indicated.
womanUrineTokenGuidance: Urine protein/ketone alert: correlate proteinuria with BP for pre-eclampsia, and manage ketonuria with nutrition support or IV dextrose as indicated.
